summary: Completed comprehensive testing of fillet cutting feature for Ayam Fillet purchases. All backend APIs and frontend UI components working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: Login as owner/admin123 successful
Backend: GET /api/products returns Ayam Fillet with correct stock fields
Backend: GET /api/suppliers returns supplier list
Backend: POST /api/purchases with pcs_after (5 -> 10) creates purchase correctly
Backend: Purchase response contains correct fields: qty_unit='pcs', pcs_supplier=5, pcs=10, avg_weight=0.4, buy_price_kg=50000, buy_price_pcs=20000
Backend: Stock increases correctly: stock_kg +4, stock_pcs +10 (not +5), stock_ekor unchanged
Backend: PUT /api/purchases updates purchase correctly (5 -> 8 pcs)
Backend: PUT /api/purchases without pcs_after falls back to ekor (5 pcs)
Backend: DELETE /api/purchases restores stock to initial values
Backend: Ayam Broiler regression test passes (whole chicken still works with qty_unit='ekor')
Frontend: /pembelian page loads successfully
Frontend: 'Pembelian Baru' dialog opens
Frontend: Supplier selection works
Frontend: Ayam Fillet product selection works
Frontend: 'Total Pcs Setelah Dipotong' field appears ONLY for Ayam Fillet (testid: pur-pcs-after-0)
Frontend: Default value in pcs_after field equals supplier quantity (5 pcs)
Frontend: Helper text (testid: pur-avg-0) shows correct calculation: '0,8 kg/pcs' for 4 kg / 5 pcs
Frontend: Summary row 'Perkiraan Harga/pcs' (testid: pur-price-pcs) shows Rp 40.000 (200000 / 5)
Frontend: Changing pcs_after to 10 updates helper text to '0,4 kg/pcs' and '10 pcs'
Frontend: Price per pcs updates to Rp 20.000 (200000 / 10)
Frontend: Total pcs display (testid: pur-total-pcs) shows '5 pcs supplier → 10 pcs'
Frontend: Changing product to Ayam Broiler hides 'Total Pcs Setelah Dipotong' field
Frontend: Changing product to Ayam Broiler hides 'Perkiraan Harga/pcs' row
Frontend: Label changes from 'Jumlah (pcs)' to 'Jumlah (ekor)' for Ayam Broiler
E2E: Purchase creation saves successfully with toast notification
E2E: Edit dialog (Koreksi Pembelian) opens and displays correct values (Jumlah=5, Total Pcs Setelah Dipotong=10)
E2E: Purchase deletion works and restores stock

success_percentage.frontend: 100% (all UI elements and calculations working correctly)
